hero_desc: An inspiring setting of charm, authenticity and expertise for over 40 years.
wedding_section_subtitle: The Most Beautiful Day of Your Life
wedding_quote: An inspiring setting, between charm and authenticity.
wedding_p2: For over forty years, L’Hostellerie Saint-Louis has been an exceptional venue for weddings. The whole team will be fully involved to make this day one of your happiest memories.
wedding_p3: We will draw on our expertise and our preferred partners (florists, photographers, DJs, decorators) to make your event an unforgettable moment that matters to you and your guests.
wedding_p4: Every wedding we host is unique. We will accompany you every step of the way so that you can savour the day to the full, in complete peace of mind.
capacity_section_desc: Flexible and elegant spaces to welcome your guests in the best possible conditions.
cap1_desc: Up to 60 guests for a seated meal. Ideal for wedding banquets and large family receptions.
cap2_desc: From 12 to 30 guests. Perfect for birthdays, christenings or small committees.
cap3_desc: Outdoor space and adjoining terraces for your drinks reception and seasonal cocktails.
reception_section_desc: Birthdays, family gatherings, christenings, get-togethers with friends... Think of L’Hostellerie Saint-Louis for a warm and memorable occasion.
rcard1_desc: We are used to hosting bespoke groups with tailored packages (catering only, accommodation or half board).
rcard2_desc: A total capacity of 63 guests. We have a large number of TWIN rooms (2 separate beds), ideal for your guests’ comfort.
rcard3_desc: We are at your disposal to compose and plan your reception menus or all-inclusive stays (function rooms, accommodation, meals).
rcard4_desc: Large free car park at the front and rear for your vehicles. We also provide bicycle parking with electric charging for cyclists.
partner_banner_desc: We can put you in touch with local partners to enrich your stay (guided tours, tastings, cultural and sporting activities).
trust_section_desc: Discover a few snapshots captured during the weddings and receptions held at our house.
quote_desc: Please feel free to contact us for any information or to create your bespoke package together. Our events team will get back to you within 24 hours.
